  • Aviation & infrastructure: Commercial airspace/airports closed across the region (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight volumes diverted/reduced.
  • Domestic security: Police arrested two suspects in an attack on Democratic activists in south Tel Aviv. A US national at a Jerusalem yeshiva charged with spying for Iran.
  • Other: Reports of procurement and media-security incidents in Russia/Iran; cultural/sports items not operationally relevant.
  • 🟢 Good News: Local police arrested suspects in Tel Aviv attack. No major new civilian evacuation notices in these reports.
  • Threat assessment: escalating

  • Airspace & Transport: Regional airports largely closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Commercial flights sharply reduced.
  • Diplomacy / Mediation: Pakistan mediating talks. Accusations surfaced that Israel plotted to target mediators — increases political risk and could derail negotiations.
  • Iran domestic / Leadership: Mass funeral events for Khamenei. Tehran tightening security; partial airspace closures for ceremonies. Russian officials attending.
  • Operational note: Strikes and counterstrikes persistent despite pauses. Targeting patterns show continued use of airpower and proxy missile barrages.
  • International moves: Russia/India/China afforded passage through Hormuz. No major troop deployments or new direct intervention reported.
  • 🟢 Good News: A US-declared 10-day pause gives a temporary diplomatic window; Pakistan is engaged as mediator.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
